description: **The unified site's root redirect stub declares an absolute canonical.** It emitted a root-relative `rel=canonical`, so every hostname bound to the site claimed to be the canonical one.

**The assembly portfolio page now declares a canonical URL.** `assembly generate-shared` splices a `rel=canonical` link into the portfolio it copies to the site root, taken from the new required `--portfolio-canonical` flag (`assembly.portfolio_canonical`, templated into the generated deploy workflow). Supplying a portfolio file without it is a hard error -- there is no default, because the portfolio's canonical is the apex rather than the docs base.
